nodes.label: Case file (.court/case.md)
nodes.author: Alex Chen (@nocodealex)
nodes.rationale: Sub-agents cannot see the conversation, so the case file must stand alone and must not lean one way or add facts.

nodes.label: Conditions for acquittal
nodes.author: Alex Chen (@nocodealex)
nodes.rationale: Used to seed a retrial when the user disagrees, instead of the clerk arguing.

nodes.label: Jury of 12 Claudes
nodes.author: Alex Chen (@nocodealex)
nodes.rationale: Jurors with different backgrounds vote independently and never see each other, avoiding groupthink.

nodes.label: court skill
nodes.author: Alex Chen (@nocodealex)
nodes.rationale: Counters Claude's tendency to agree with everything by putting an idea on trial with adversarial sub-agents and an independent jury.

nodes.label: Clerk of the court role
nodes.author: Alex Chen (@nocodealex)
nodes.rationale: Main agent never argues, votes, or softens the verdict; a guilty verdict is useful information, not bad news to cushion.

nodes.label: graphify skill (/graphify trigger)
nodes.rationale: Project-level instruction: on /graphify, use the installed graphify skill before anything else.

nodes.label: Example: Over-abstraction (discount strategy)
nodes.rationale: Add complexity only when multiple discount types are actually needed.

nodes.label: Simplicity First
nodes.rationale: Minimum code that solves the problem, nothing speculative.

nodes.label: Think Before Coding
nodes.rationale: Don't assume, don't hide confusion, surface tradeoffs.

nodes.label: CLAUDE.md behavioral guidelines
nodes.rationale: Bias toward caution over speed to reduce common LLM coding mistakes; for trivial tasks use judgment.

nodes.label: Cursor integration guide
nodes.rationale: Cursor does not read .claude-plugin/ or CLAUDE.md, so a committed alwaysApply project rule is used.

nodes.label: Keep CLAUDE.md, .mdc rule and SKILL.md in sync
nodes.norm_label: keep claude.md, .mdc rule and skill.md in sync

nodes.label: Goal-Driven Execution
nodes.rationale: Transform tasks into verifiable goals and loop until verified.

nodes.label: Key insight: give success criteria, not instructions
nodes.norm_label: key insight: give success criteria, not instructions
nodes.rationale: LLMs are exceptionally good at looping until they meet specific goals.

nodes.label: Surgical Changes
nodes.rationale: Touch only what you must; every changed line traces to the request.
